education_level_institution_type.label: Education level / institution type
education_level_institution_type.value: Postsecondary universities for working adults (Strayer University, Capella University), plus employer-focused education services and coding/skills programs

program_qualification.label: Program / qualification
program_qualification.value: Associate, bachelor's, master's and doctoral degrees, certificates, online MBA (Jack Welch Management Institute), non-degree skill pathways

tuition_payment_model.label: Tuition / payment model
tuition_payment_model.value: Employer-funded tuition: Tuition Assistance Aligned Pricing, fixed-fee annual Degrees@Work model, and other flexible pricing; tuition assistance platform

accreditation_authorization.label: Accreditation / authorization
accreditation_authorization.value: Described as accredited universities; named accreditor not given in the evidence

delivery_campus_model.label: Delivery / campus model
delivery_campus_model.value: Mostly online (Capella, FlexPath/GuidedPath, JWMI 100% online); Strayer offers online, on-campus and hybrid options

notes: Enrollment and outcome figures are not in the evidence; Australia/New Zealand operations are not covered.
